title: Find Two Non-overlapping Sub-arrays Each With Target Sum
summary: Given an array of integers arr and an integer target, find two non-overlapping sub-arrays of arr such that the sum of each sub-array equals the target.
statement: Given an array of integers arr and an integer target, find two non-overlapping sub-arrays of arr such that the sum of each sub-array equals the target. The objective is to minimize the sum of the lengths of these two sub-arrays. Return the minimum sum of the lengths of the two sub-arrays, or return -1 if no such sub-arrays can be found.
constraints: Choose two non-overlapping subarrays each summing to target and minimize their combined lengths; return -1 if impossible.
hints: Positive values allow one sliding window to find every target-sum interval.
Store at each index the shortest target interval ending at or before it.
When a new interval starts at left, combine it with the stored best through left-1.
This considers every right-hand interval with the optimal non-overlapping left partner.
editorial: This considers every right-hand interval with the optimal non-overlapping left partner.
